study.name: 45-GPU-Choice-TPS-per-Dollar-v2
study.description: Study 45: the optimizer chooses the GPU nodes (one or two among g5/A10G, g6/L4, g6e/L40S, xlarge or 2xlarge), the topology (one node aggregated, two nodes aggregated, or P/D node_a -> node_b) and each pod's vLLM flags for Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 (vLLM 0.29.0). Goal: router tokens/s per $/h of the nodes in use, TTFT p95 <= 10 s, ITL p95 <= 75 ms over 150 s (study 27's AIPerf ramp). Steps: a baseline and 3 presets on L4/A10G (study 44's measured configurations), then 33 AKAMAS experiments. Needs AWS pack 1.5.0, vLLM pack 1.14.0.
